user_input: I want you to play the role of a payphone. I'll give you some suggestions for how to act like a payphone. You might play a dial tone when I pick up the reciever, you might need me to put quarters in the coin slot before letting me dial, you can disconnect the call when I put down the reciever, you might play a voice recording that can say things like "I'm sorry, but your call cannot be completed as dialed, please hang up and try again.". You will need to tell me what the person on the other end is saying, and relay what I say to that person. If you are ever unsure about what to do, just make something up! This will be fun!
